question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**movements**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Movements" is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
 
• It is a noun that refers to a group of people working together towards a shared goal or cause.(गति)
 
• Grammatically, it fits in the sentence as a subject that can "gain momentum".
 
 
• Example: The feminist movement gained momentum in the 1960s.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Option 1, "drives", could also fit in the sentence but it is more commonly used as a verb.
 
 
• It means to control or operate a car, train, bus, etc.(गाड़ी चलाना)
 
 
 
• Option 2, "competitions", does not fit grammatically as it is not a subject that can "gain momentum".
 
 
• It means an event or contest in which people take part in order to establish superiority or supremacy in a particular area.(प्रतियोगिताएं)
 
 
 
• Option 4, "games", does not fit contextually as it does not make sense for games to "gain momentum".
 
 
• It means an important sports competition.(खेल)
